# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 15 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Supply: GLS Tenders Launched in Orchard & Marina South

- **Two new GLS sites in Marina South and Orchard Boulevard could add around 500 homes** - The government has released two Government Land Sales plots — one in Marina South and one along Orchard Boulevard — that could together add approximately 500 private homes to the pipeline, with both sites expected to draw strong developer interest. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/two-new-gls-sites-released-in-marina-south-and-orchard-boulevard/)

- **Analysts expect keen bids for the two Central Region sites despite rising land prices** - The Orchard Boulevard plot spans 37,006 sq ft and the Marina Gardens Lane site covers 64,663 sq ft; analysts anticipate competitive tender bids on the back of recent sales momentum, though rising land costs are noted as a factor in the market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/2-prime-residential-sites-released-orchard-marina-south/)

## HDB Resale: Buyer Priorities and Record Prices

- **Survey: 77% of HDB owners prioritise accessibility and neighbourhood ties over prestige in their next home** - A 2026 PropNex survey of 1,530 HDB owners found that only 55.1% still aspire to private housing, with accessibility and community connections now ranking above price or space in upgrading decisions. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/a-new-survey-reveals-what-77-of-hdb-owners-want-most-in-their-next-home-and-its-not-price-or-space/)

- **Clementi Crest holds two town-wide HDB resale price records just over a year after entering the resale market** - The project along Clementi Avenue 3 only reached its Minimum Occupation Period in 2025 and has since repeatedly pushed up Clementi's resale benchmarks, now holding two town-wide records. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-crest-hdb-resale-record-prices/)

## Lease Decay and Older Stock: What Buyers Are Asking

- **Lease decay is becoming a bigger consideration as Singapore's housing stock ages** - A shorter remaining lease can affect CPF usage, financing options, future demand, and resale ease, with buyers and homeowners increasingly raising questions about older properties. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/ask-an-agent-your-lease-decay-property-questions-answered/)
